caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sideboard consisting of two main sections: an upper and a lower compartment. The overall color scheme is various shades of brown, typical of stained or aged wood. The upper compartment features two carved pillars, one on each side, supporting a flat, rectangular top with carved patterns along its edge. In the upper central section are two cabinet doors, adorned with geometric and circular carved designs as well as keyhole accents; these doors create a small storage space. The three visible sides of the upper compartment include decorative carvings and a thick border. The lower compartment is a larger rectangular cabinet, featuring two drawers positioned side by side beneath the upper section, each drawer with a simple round handle. Below the drawers are two larger cabinet doors, each with a single round knob, separated by a vertical wooden divide. The sides of the lower compartment are plain wood, and the whole structure stands on four straight legs, also made of wood, that are square in cross-section. Both the upper and lower edges of the structure are highlighted by bands of ornate carved patterns. The overall composition centers the sideboard within the drawing, providing a clear, full-frontal view of the furniture.
title: Press Cupboard
